name: Tooltip

tokens.note: Horizontal padding is --measurement-6 (6px), a raw measurement rather than a semantic spacing token - Figma's own value doesn't land on the 4/8/12/16px spacing scale.

behaviorRules: Supports disabled native controls with a non-focusable pointer wrapper.
Does not render or attach behavior when content is absent.
Skips internal behavior when consumer handlers prevent default.
